rules: A receipt is a CLAIM by the Forge server about one attempt, recorded durably by the backend. It is not a permission and it does not prove a physical effect.

result NO_EFFECT: executed=true, reason empty, pre_hash == post_hash (lowercase sha256 of the observed fixtures), accepted only while the ledger row is EXECUTING (the durable EXECUTION_STARTED marker exists). Terminal state NO_EFFECT_VERIFIED.

result PRECONDITION_FAILED: executed=false, reason one of PRECONDITION_FAILED | START_ACK_LOST | REQUESTER_GONE, pre_hash and post_hash empty. Accepted from RESERVED or EXECUTING. Terminal state FAILED_NO_EFFECT.
world_effects is always false in this milestone. Different hashes are never a NO_EFFECT receipt: the Forge side reports HOLD instead and nothing is finalized.
A terminal is stored with the sha256 of the canonical receipt; a replay with the same bytes returns the stored result, any other evidence for a terminal task is refused.
